preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The total number of squares is at least 2.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and all(c.isdigit() or c.isspace() for c in lines[0])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains two space-separated integers n and m.

postconditions.description: The output path contains exactly n*m + 1 coordinates.
The path starts and ends at the capital (1, 1).
The capital (1, 1) appears exactly twice in the path (start and end).
Every square in the n x m grid appears exactly once in the path, except the capital which appears twice.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= r <= n and 1 <= c <= m for r, c in path)
postconditions.description: All coordinates in the path are within the grid boundaries.

postconditions.expression: all((abs(path[i][0] - path[i+1][0] + abs(path[i][1] - path[i+1][1]) == 1) or (path[i+1] in [t[2:] for t in teleporters if t[0:2] == path[i]])) for i in range(len(path)-1))
postconditions.description: Each consecutive step in the path is either a move to a side-neighboring square or a jump via a teleporter installed at the current square.
The number of teleporters k matches the number of teleporter definitions provided.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2 in teleporters)
postconditions.description: All teleporter source and destination coordinates are within the grid boundaries.

postconditions.expression: len(set((t[0], t[1]) for t in teleporters)) == len(teleporters)
postconditions.description: No two teleporters are installed on the same square.
The number of teleporters k is the minimum required to complete the journey.
